value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for kids 1 (walking) to 3 years with a parent - their site lists lots of times, like Mon 9:30, Tue 9:45, Sat 9:15, Sun 8:30, for Term 1 (Sept 14-Nov 1). No price or registration date is posted yet. I'll keep watching and text you when they add those.
